transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I just keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up anymore. Just... go to sleep and that's it. Sometimes I feel like dying would just be... fair. Like a fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and the guys on my crew.
Have you had any specific thoughts about how you would end your life, or do you have a plan in mind?
No. No plan. Just... what I said before. That it would be better to just... not wake up. Like a fair trade for... everything. I don't know.
Have you been feeling guilty or like you're a burden to others, especially your family and crew?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I know I'm the reason my husband got worse. And the crew, they lost work because of me. I messed up clients' homes, the floors... it's just... I don't know. It feels like I poison everything I touch. So... I just deserve whatever happens to me. That's all.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time lately?
Yeah. I guess so. Most days, just... down.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with loved ones?

Yeah... I don't really do much anymore. I used to... I don't know, paint. Cook big meals. Run before jobs. I even used to go to theater rehearsals. But... it just feels different now. Like they're just... chores from somebody else's life. I don't really care if I miss them.
Do you often feel that you are a bad person, or that you deserve to be punished for things you've done?

I mean... yeah. Like I said before. I just keep thinking about... how it's my fault he got worse. And the crew... the floors I messed up. I just... I already told you, I ruin things. So... yeah. I feel like I deserve it.
Do your feelings of being down or depressed happen nearly every day, and do they last most of the day?

Yeah, I guess. It's... pretty much all the time. Since this whole thing started, the... the guilt, feeling so tired, not caring about the painting or anything... and just wishing I wasn't here. It's just always there. Some weeks are maybe a little less... heavy, but it doesn't go away. Most of the day. Every day.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you were down or lost interest in things for a long time, more than just a couple of weeks?
Yeah... it's been a while. I guess... maybe about a year and two months now. It started a few months after... after my husband got hurt. It just hasn't really stopped since then.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than just a few weeks, before this most recent episode started?
No... I don't think so. Not before all this. Before he got hurt, I just... I went to work and did my job. It wasn't like this.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in most things before the time your husband got hurt?
No. Like I said, not before that. I was fine.
Have you ever had a time before this current period where you felt down or lost interest in most things for at least two weeks in a row?
No. I already said that. I was fine before.
Have you ever had any other times in your life, before your husband got hurt, where you felt down or lost interest in most things for more than just a few weeks?
I don't... I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. No. Like I just told you, I didn't feel like this back then.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in most things before the time your husband got hurt?
I... I just answered this. No. I wasn't like this before.
Have you ever had a time in your life before your husband got hurt when you felt down or lost interest in most things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don't know what you want me to say. I already told you no.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in most things for at least two weeks in a row?
I... look, the answer hasn't changed. No. I don't have anything else to tell you about that.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in most things for at least two weeks in a row?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing over and over. I said no. I wasn't like this before.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in most things for at least two weeks in a row?
I... I don't know what else to say. I've told you no. Just... no. I wasn't like this before.
